title: A two-page spread sharing a master
concept: Two pages in one spread, each applying the same master by its Self id.

annotations.note: PageCount=2: this spread holds two pages side by side. ShowMasterItems=true lets the master's items stamp onto each page.
The left page. Its ItemTransform shifts the page's inner origin to x=-595.276 so it sits to the left of the binding.
Both pages carry AppliedMaster="umaster" — the bare Self id of the MasterSpread, not its src path.
The right page sits at the spread origin (identity translation).
